identical_start_with_and_without_the_che.off_arm: the practice study's recorded identity, obtained by a process that ran NO checkpoint check and had a wholly different RNG history -- which is why this comparison IS the with-versus-without comparison

identical_start_with_and_without_the_che.reason: R1-2. identical_start_with_and_without_the_che.why_there_is_no_independent_measurement_: a second arm cannot be built. Perturbing this job's own RNG to build a third arm would change the numerics of the model that trains, on a spend path, for a field that is already covered.
